integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible exact-rational checks; no claim of independent validation or publication certification.
scientific_limitations: The complete basin classification holds for the equilateral map on three infinite supporting lines with exact farthest perpendicular projection and the tie-as-fixed convention. Its nonconvergent density applies to one-sided directed arclength cutoffs, not symmetric cutoffs or perturbed triangles. The two equilateral three-cycle existence statements are covered by prior work; the global basin and exact log-periodic density are the present contribution. Research originality is subject to residual unpublished or unlocated literature.
title: Log-periodic attraction-basin densities for an equilateral farthest-projection map
